fixtureScrutiny.a: Only setup seeding mutates state (probe encodeEnvelope); no src changes; all actions are real UI clicks/taps.
fixtureScrutiny.b: Documented in probe.mjs header, evidence.md and results.json.
fixtureScrutiny.c: Seeded envelope passes the game's full decodeSave/validateSim; no invariant weakened or bypassed.
fixtureScrutiny.d: Actions flow through dispatch->applyCommand; localStorage read only as the game's own persistence mirror.

findings.detail: The mature fixture holds exactly 10 steel and TUNING.reserveFloor=10, so the engine's sellableAmount(steel)=held-(reserveFloor+machineInputDemand)=0. tradeFaces() therefore omits a steel trade card while still listing steel (stock 10) in the Inventory section. This is the reserve floor protecting starter stock by construction, not a mislabeled or unreachable control. The sell step sells the dearest genuinely-sellable face (circuits/plates) through its real Max preset + Sell button.
findings.source: src/ui/store/model.ts tradeFaces; src/game/simulation/commands.ts sellableAmount; src/game/content/defs.ts reserveFloor=10, EXPORT_PRICES.steel=10

findings.detail: With a machine selected (selected>0) at tutorial>=8 the dock renders the machine's upgrade-branch row instead of the resting Store/Build faces; closing the inspector panel does not clear selection. Tapping an empty yard cell (pickTarget=null -> setSelected(null)) returns the dock to rest. This is the documented one-selection dock model, and the empty-yard tap is a real, reachable player path. No dead-end.

When wreck.remaining reaches 0 the engine increments generation and refills remaining to starterWreckPool(30), so manual salvage and drone delivery never dead-end. Confirmed across the opening salvage loop.

BELT-001 charges beltCostPerTile(1) x run tiles of scrap per connection (connectRoute -> spendFromStore). After repair(30)+sorter(20) the opening yard is at 0 scrap, so the guided 'Connect dock to sorter' primary refuses on the first tap. The refusal IS surfaced: a 1.8s shortfall toast (reject.shortfall need/have) plus the persistent 'Last need...' resting-line tail. The dock Connect face does not pre-print the belt scrap cost (minor tutorial friction), but this is NOT a dead-end: the drone delivers 5 scrap every ~5s and the wreck regenerates, so the player banks scrap and connects. The probe waits for the drone (real idle earn path) then connects through the same guided primary; routes form and tutorial advances to 6.
findings.source: src/game/simulation/commands.ts connectRoute/beltCost; src/game/content/defs.ts beltCostPerTile=1; src/ui/App.tsx setToast/setLastReject + reject.shortfall
